what: A falsifiable check for whether this agent can actually see image pixels.
how: Open TOOLS/vision-canary/vision-canary.png with whatever image-reading capability you have.
Read the single word printed across the top, the shape below it, and that shape's colour.
It answers PASS or FAIL. A FAIL means you cannot see pixels -- say so, do not claim visual verification.
why_hashed: The expected answer is stored only as a SHA-256 of '<word>|<shape>|<colour>' in lower case. Reading this repository cannot substitute for looking at the image, which is the entire point: 'screenshot captured' and 'agent inspected the pixels' are different claims.
